summary: Katie's Pet Depot is a single-location independent pet supply store at 416 Renaissance Blvd in North Brunswick, NJ, operating a Shopify web store alongside in-store grooming, live animals, shelter adoptions and free local delivery. Online it sells natural/holistic food and supplies with a 5% Subscribe & Save program, 48-hour delivery inside a 10-mile radius, a customer account area and a monthly vendor-rebate offers page. Grooming is still booked by phone, delivery instructions are typed into a cart notes field, and the site's careers and events pages look abandoned, which points to a small team carrying a lot of manual coordination.

facts.fact: Single location at 416 Renaissance Blvd, North Brunswick, NJ 08902, phone (732) 422-0056; store hours Monday-Saturday 10:00 AM-7:00 PM and Sunday 10:00 AM-6:00 PM.
Positioning: 'natural pet food headquarters' with premium food, pet supplies, expert grooming, live animals, shelter adoptions and staff assistance.

Grooming packages include nails, ears, eyes, blow dry and brush out, starting at $54 ($69 with a haircut); the page asks customers to call for a quote and appointment and says appointments are typically scheduled.

Local delivery: orders delivered within 48 hours of placement, free over $49 within a 10-mile radius; a published list of roughly 80+ accepted ZIP codes spanning Middlesex, Union, Somerset and Monmouth counties plus Staten Island (10307).
Subscription ordering on all food and treat products with 5% savings, and customers can cancel, skip or freeze orders and view order history in their account.

Current promotions page lists about a dozen manufacturer offers (Stella & Chewy's, Fussie Cat, Natural Balance, Icelandic+, Dr. Marty's, Wholesomes, Dave's) with validity windows through Nov-Dec 2026.

In-store events page describes adoption events, dog/puppy adoptions with a rescue partner, and VIP Petcare wellness clinics offering vaccines and microchips with no appointment needed; listed dates are from an earlier year.
Store blog publishes seasonal pet-care advice articles, with entries dated through fall (Thanksgiving, Halloween, fall allergies, late-summer checklist).
The main navigation's Careers link points to a job-postings page that returned HTTP 404 when checked.
Aggregated Google review listing shows 218 comments, with recent reviews (April 2026) praising helpful, knowledgeable staff, a long-tenured groomer, toy variety and the store's convenience.
Page sitemap shows the Subscribe and Save page last updated 2024-10-24 and the local delivery / services pages last updated May 2023.

operations_signals: Grooming appointments are handled by phone only - the grooming page directs customers to call for a quote and booking, and no online booking widget appears on the site (https://katiesnj.com/pages/grooming-1).
Local delivery orders depend on free-text instructions typed into the shopping cart 'Notes' field rather than a scheduling or delivery-window tool (https://katiesnj.com/pages/local-delivery).
Store hours are Mon-Sat 10-7 and Sun 10-6 with no after-hours or emergency channel published; contact options are phone and an email form (https://katiesnj.com/apps/pages/locations).

Repeat-purchase operations run on Shopify subscription ordering plus a monthly vendor-rebate offers page, so staff field subscription changes and coupon/rebate questions (https://katiesnj.com/pages/subscribe-and-save; https://katiesnj.com/apps/pages/offers).

In-store service demand is event-driven: adoption days, rescue-partner dog adoptions and walk-in VIP Petcare wellness clinics all happen on fixed dates at the store (https://katiesnj.com/pages/events).
Service area is broad for a single store: 48-hour delivery across 80+ ZIP codes in central/northern New Jersey plus Staten Island (https://katiesnj.com/pages/local-delivery).
hiring_signals: No current openings are published: the Careers link in the main navigation resolves to a 404 page (https://katiesnj.com/a/pages/job-postings).

Job-board checks returned no visible Katie's Pet Depot postings, and Indeed, ZipRecruiter and LinkedIn blocked automated access, so recent hiring could not be confirmed (https://www.indeed.com/jobs?q=%22Katie%27s+Pet+Depot%22&l=North+Brunswick%2C+NJ).
review_themes: Praise for staff knowledge and friendliness is the dominant theme in the visible recent reviews, with reviewers describing employees helping them with everything they needed (https://www.loc8nearme.com/new-jersey/north-brunswick/katies-pet-depot/2900021/).

A long-tenured groomer is called out by name and described as an added bonus and 'a friend over the years', suggesting grooming is a loyalty anchor (https://www.loc8nearme.com/new-jersey/north-brunswick/katies-pet-depot/2900021/).

Reviewers cite wide product variety, well-cared-for animals, competitive prices versus chain stores and the delivery option as reasons to return (https://www.loc8nearme.com/new-jersey/north-brunswick/katies-pet-depot/2900021/).

No complaints about slow responses, missed calls or billing errors appeared in the small visible sample, but only three recent reviews were readable, so absence of complaints is not evidence of smooth operations (https://www.loc8nearme.com/new-jersey/north-brunswick/katies-pet-depot/2900021/).
tech_footprint: E-commerce runs on Shopify, with collection-based catalog navigation (dog, cat, small animal, fish, reptile, wild bird) and customer accounts (https://katiesnj.com/).

Subscription/recurring order capability is native to the storefront: frequency selection at checkout, 5% discount, self-service skip/freeze and order history (https://katiesnj.com/pages/subscribe-and-save).

Vendor promotions are delivered through Astro Loyalty - offer images are served from api.astroloyalty.com, a rebate/loyalty platform common among independent pet retailers (https://katiesnj.com/apps/pages/offers).

A third-party store-locator widget ('metastock') holds one location; its configuration shows delivery and pickup flags both set to 0, indicating no BOPIS/delivery toggle is exposed there (https://katiesnj.com/).
Marketing stack visible on site: newsletter email capture, blog for SEO content, and a monthly-refreshed offers app page; no live chat or SMS widget observed (https://katiesnj.com/).
No online grooming booking, intake form or appointment calendar was found; the only path is a phone number (https://katiesnj.com/pages/grooming-1).
Site carries an accessibility statement page, last generated in 2021, showing periodic compliance attention (https://katiesnj.com/pages/accessibility-statement).
growth_signals: Subscribe and Save launched/refreshed around October 2024, adding recurring revenue on food and treats (https://katiesnj.com/sitemap_pages_1.xml?from=241981577&to=142520615214).
Local delivery was formalized in 2023 with a 48-hour promise, a $49 free-delivery threshold and an explicit 80+ ZIP service area list (https://katiesnj.com/pages/local-delivery).
Content marketing is active: seasonal advice articles continue into the current year, pointing to ongoing SEO/localsearch investment (https://katiesnj.com/blogs/news).
Manufacturer promotions are rotated monthly with Nov-Dec 2026 validity dates, indicating an active vendor-rebate calendar (https://katiesnj.com/apps/pages/offers).
Event marketing appears dormant: the events page still shows adoption and wellness-clinic dates from an earlier season (https://katiesnj.com/pages/events).
decision_maker: Unknown - no owner, GM or manager is named on katiesnj.com's home, services, grooming, delivery, locations, events, blog or offers pages, and no company profile listing an executive was accessible

inferences.inference: Grooming demand is almost certainly constrained by phone capacity, creating missed calls and scheduling friction at peak times.
inferences.reasoning: The grooming page routes every quote and booking to a single store phone number, lists tiered pricing that invites questions, and no online booking tool exists; a single-location store with one named groomer plus packages cannot absorb call volume during weekend hours.

inferences.inference: Order fulfillment has manual handoffs that could produce delivery errors.
inferences.reasoning: Delivery instructions are free-text cart notes, delivery is promised within 48 hours, and the service area spans 80+ ZIP codes from one store, so routing and cutoff decisions are made by staff rather than by software.

inferences.inference: The business is run by a small team that updates the website episodically rather than continuously.
inferences.reasoning: The Careers link 404s, the events page still lists past-year dates, and several service pages carry 2023 last-modified dates while only the offers and blog sections are current.

inferences.inference: Subscription and rebate support is a plausible AI-agent entry point with measurable ROI.
inferences.reasoning: Subscribe & Save plus a monthly vendor-rebate page generate recurring 'skip/freeze/cancel' and 'is this coupon valid' questions that are repetitive, policy-bounded and phone/email driven.

inferences.inference: This is a small independent retailer, likely in the low tens of employees.
inferences.reasoning: One storefront, one store-locator entry, a single published phone number, and no corporate/leadership pages or press coverage found; this is an inference, not a published headcount.

data_gaps: Decision-maker name and title not found; no About/Our Team page and no accessible company profile or news article naming an owner.
Headcount, revenue and years in business not published on the site or in accessible directories.
Current hiring activity unconfirmed - Indeed, ZipRecruiter, LinkedIn and Glassdoor blocked automated access (HTTP 403) and the site's careers page is a 404.
Yelp and BBB pages returned HTTP 403, so star ratings and complaint history could not be verified; only a search-result description of the Yelp listing was visible.
Google review text was available only through a third-party mirror (loc8nearme) showing three recent reviews out of 218; no systematic read of negative reviews was possible.
Events page dates could not be tied to a specific year, so whether adoption/wellness events are still running is unverified.

A similarly branded Shopify storefront at katiesn.com (branded 'Katie's Pet', with generic '10,000+ pets' and 'free shipping USA' claims) appeared in search results; whether it belongs to this business or is unrelated was not verified.
